# Archived upstream workflows

These workflows are preserved unchanged from evcc 0.319.0. They are outside the active workflow directory because they depend on upstream runners, services, secrets and release destinations.

The fork uses `./.github/workflows/heidelberg.yml`. On future upstream updates, review and archive any new upstream workflows before enabling them in the fork. See `./docs/HEIDELBERG_1P3P.md` for the release and approval process.
